promise: Huang predicted that the worldwide installed value of data centers would grow from about $1 trillion to $2 trillion over four to five years.
description: At the World Government Summit in Dubai, Huang forecast growth in the installed data-center base. He did not promise that every existing facility would be converted to accelerated computing.
evidence: The contemporary report describes a four-to-five-year forecast.
Earlier February 13 reporting shows February 14 cannot be assumed to be the speech date.

review.note: DCD's February 14 date is publication, not the Dubai speech date; February 13 coverage already reports the same remarks. The prediction concerns installed data-center value, not a commitment that all facilities become accelerated computing. The exact due day computed from publication is unsupported.
